spanish: Y vinieron los pastores y las echaron; y Moisés se levantó, y las rescató, y dio de beber a su rebaño.

units.es: y dio de beber a su rebaño

adjudication.decision: Retain the coordinated actions without adding adversative or temporal connectors, preserve the daughters as the feminine object, render the result of ישׁע as «las rescató» rather than the more interpretive means «las defendió», and keep their flock as expressed in this verse.
adjudication.scope: verse wording; not STATUS.md done approval
